The correct sentence should likely be "THESE A GULL GLIDED PEACEFULLY TO MY CHAIR" (if spaces were implied) or the agent failed to realize the 'D' was part of a different word or the sentence structure was flawed. However, the most glaring error is the grammatical nonsense "These a gull" and the mis-parsing of the letter sequence which resulted in an invalid sentence structure compared to the raw data.
